messages:
taylor: quick thought 	6 browser SDK onramp: add a tiny JSON POST at the edge that translates to our internal protobuf/gRPC stream. removes grpc-web requirement for frontends. main tradeoffs: extra gateway layer, telemetry/quotas mapping. opinions? :thinking_face:
jess: ergonomics are huge for product teams. main worries: Console visibility (will dashboards show model-level metrics?) and CORS/auth edge cases.
omar: quota/billing concern 	6 gateway must resolve client creds -> tenant id before counting. otherwise billing/ratelimit misattribution. require tenant header copied into translated request.
sam: grpc-web preserves streaming and exact token accounting but bumps frontend deps. If we do a shim, preserve headers and add a translation trace/span so Console can see both hops.
taylor: header sketch: X-RW-ORIG-ROUTE, X-RW-MODEL, X-RW-CLIENT-TYPE, X-RW-TENANT-ID, plus a translation span id. also emit events translate.started/translate.finished.
omar: big ops question: where to count quota? at edge for speed or runtime for accuracy? propose optimistic count at edge + async reconciliation job that emits reconcile.quota_delta and alerts on drift > 0.5%.
jess: rollout plan: feature flag + canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%, watch translation.p95 < 20ms, translate.error < 0.2%, quota_mismatch < 0.3%. require traces include translation span. rollback if any breach.
deploy-bot: CI note 	6 add canary in eng-platform, metrics translate.success, translate.latency_p95, model.latency_p95, quota_mismatch_rate. automate pause on SLO breach.
taylor: cool, i'll draft RFC with header mapping, telemetry events, reconciliation job, and canary steps. will @jess @omar for review. thanks! :sparkles:
